name_input: BOMBAY SUPER HYBRID SEEDS LIMITED; BOMBAY SUPER HYBRID SEEDS LIMITED; BOMBAY SUPER HYBRID SEEDS LIMITED; BOMBAY SUPER HYBRID SEEDS LIMITED; BOMBAY SUPER HYBRID SEEDS LIMITED; BOMBAY SUPER HYBRID SEEDS LIMITED; BOMBAY SUPER HYBRID SEEDS LIMITED
export_evidence: ImportKey page for 'bombay-super-hybrid-seeds-limited' (https://importkey.com/countries/india/bombay-super-hybrid-seeds-limited) shows 23 records, all on the IMPORT side (company as BUYER), e.g. exact line: "2026-02-12 | CHIA TAI SEEDS CO. LTD. | BOMBAY SUPER HYBRID SEEDS LIMITED | VEGETABLE SEEDS FOR PLANTING AND SOWING - BITTER GOURD SEEDS- VAR - NOREE 204 | BANGKOK, THAILAND -> SAHAR AIR CARGO ACC INBOM4, India | HS 12099190 | BOL 7478827"; second line: "2025-10-09 | M/S. BIOLEGUMI ITALIA S.R.L | BOMBAY SUPER HYBRID SEEDS LIMITED | CORIANDER SEEDS FOR PLANTING AND SOWING - VAR - MOROCCO | MILAN MALPENSA, ITALY -> JNPT NHAVA SHEVA SEA, India | HS 09092110 | BOL 9991776". No outbound (India -> foreign) shipment row with date/destination/BOL was seen on any accessible source. Source counter vs rows seen: ImportKey header states "Total Shipments 23 Records detected" / "Trading Partners 3" / "Ports 6", but only 5 individual rows were rendered in the free view (2026-02-12, 2025-11-13, 2025-10-09, 2025-09-03, 2025-03-02) — all imports. Slug variants tried: 'bombay-super-hybrid-seeds-limited' (23 records, import side), 'bombay-super-hybrid-seeds-ltd' (page rendered empty, no rows), 'bombay-super-hybrid-seeds' (page rendered empty, no rows). volza.com/p/bombay-super-hybrid-seeds/export/ returned HTTP 403; eximpedia.app returned HTTP 403; trademo.com returned HTTP 403; DuckDuckGo search backend was down (connection refused), so no additional export index could be queried.
domestic_evidence: Listed Indian public company with audited, published turnover — Screener.in (https://www.screener.in/company/BSHSL/consolidated/) annual P&L, exact line: "Mar 2025 (S) Sales 358" and "Mar 2026 (S) Sales 344" (Rs crore, standalone), with quarterly GST-linked sales rows e.g. "Jun 2025 (S) Sales 152.94", "Dec 2025 (S) Sales 97.87", "Mar 2026 (S) Sales 66.43". Screener company description: "Bombay Super Hybrid Seeds Ltd is engaged in processing seeds of various crops such as groundnut, onion, coriander, cumin, rajka, gram, wheat, sesame, and other agro seeds." Identifiers per Screener header: "BSE: 544757 NSE: BSHSL", website bombaysuperseeds.com. This is domestic turnover evidence (Indian seed sales), not export evidence. Note: the declared HS codes 120930 (flower seeds) and 120991 (vegetable seeds) match the observed import lines (12099190, 12099110) but no export line under those codes was found.
note: Actual shipments verified: the only customs records found are INBOUND — the company is the importer of record (vegetable/coriander seeds from Thailand, Italy, China), latest 2026-02-12, HS 12099190/09092110, BOL 7478827/9991776. No export bill of lading, no outbound date/destination pair was found on any accessible free source; export side is therefore 'none_found', not 'declared_only' — the company's own site/catalogue claims were not used as evidence. Domestic supply is confirmed by published audited turnover (Rs 358 cr FY2025, Rs 344 cr FY2026 standalone) and continuous quarterly sales, i.e. real domestic seed sales exist. Caveat on data quality: the ImportKey free view mixes in at least one clearly mis-assigned row ("2025-11-13 | UNIQLO CO. LIMITED | BOMBAY SUPER HYBRID SEEDS LIMITED | W'S PUFFTECH PARKA ... HS 62024090 | BOL 2691568"), so the 23-record counter should be treated as approximate; only 5 rows were actually visible. Revenue: Rs 358 cr (FY2025) / Rs 344 cr (FY2026), standalone, per Screener.in. Export volume: null — not public in any source consulted. No sanctions/court/HS issues assessed here (out of scope for this role); HS codes 120930/120991 are consistent with the observed seed trade, no correction needed on the evidence seen.
